Hey there! Welcome to the College of DuPage YouTube channel!

We're just 35 miles west of Chicago and home to more than 29,000 students—making us the second largest provider of undergrad education in Illinois.

Our mission? To be the ultimate spot for top-notch teaching, learning, and cool cultural experiences. We’re all about offering accessible, affordable, and comprehensive education to help you thrive.

Hit that subscribe button to stay in the loop with everything happening at COD. We’re excited to be a part of your journey! 🎓✨
